name: Berserker
source:
One of the two Berserkers that appear in the game; the servant of [url=/c3546]Gatou Monji[/url].

Her true identity is Arcueid Brunestud from Tsukihime. [spoiler]Her Noble Phantasm is called Blut die Schwester (Blood Sister).[/spoiler]
